name: WPC Selective Cart Items for WooCommerce
author: WPClever

sections.description:
WPC Selective Cart Items is a powerful WooCommerce extension that enhances the shopping cart experience by allowing customers to select specific items for checkout.

Instead of being forced to buy everything in the cart at once, users can simply check the boxes next to the items they want to purchase now. The plugin automatically updates the cart total and shipping costs based on the selection. Unselected items are safely kept in the cart and will be available for the next purchase.

Live demo

Visit our live demo here to see how this plugin works.

Key Features

  • Checkbox Selection: Adds a checkbox next to each item in the cart.
  • Dynamic Totals: Automatically recalculates subtotal, total, and shipping costs based on selected items.
  • Smart Checkout: Only selected items are processed in the checkout order.
  • Save for Later: Unselected items remain in the cart after the order is completed.
  • AJAX Support: Seamless toggling of items without page refreshes.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wpc-selective-cart-items directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Visit your cart page to see the selective checkout in action.
sections.faq:
Does this modify the actual order items?

Yes, only the items you have selected in the cart will be included in the order created at checkout.

What happens to the unselected items?

They stay in your cart! After you complete the checkout for the selected items, the unselected ones will be restored to your cart automatically.

Is it compatible with all themes?

It works with most standard WooCommerce themes. If your theme heavily customizes the cart template, some CSS adjustments might be needed.
